_doc: Tamsule at the Tidecup: gulls over the floating market and the river mouth, standing on the stilt house roofs (6.7) and the market stall roofs (2.5 to 3.3). The river is a solid greybox floor, so no fish yet. Placed on the greybox layout (M3-CRE-615); move the coordinates when env-art's kit replaces the blocks (same keys as ch02_haluna.json). Re-seated on the dressed kit (the Act I audit, 2026-10-29: tools/creatures/wildlife_snap.gd and wildlife_audit.gd, which ray against the zone's visible meshes).
